shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; ls src 2>/dev/null; cat AGENTS.md | head -30

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls __agent_eval__

grep -E '"version"|peerDep' -A8 node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/*/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head -3

grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; grep -n icons package.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -150; sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit; sed -n 200,520p $D/README.md | grep -n -i -E "styles|css|setItem|removeItem|renderer|props|layout|editMode|ActionPanel|DnD|import" | head -70; ls $D/build/esm | head -30; ls $D/build/esm/plugins $D/build/esm/typings 2>/dev/null | head -30

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit; sed -n 200,330p $D/README.md; sed -n 300,420p $D/README.md | grep -n -i -A25 "ActionPanel" | head -80; cat $D/build/esm/typings/plugin.d.ts; grep -n "styles\|css" $D/package.json; ls $D/build/esm/*.css $D/build/*/*.scss 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,80p $D/build/esm/typings/config.d.ts

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit; sed -n 8,34p $D/package.json; grep -n -i "style\|\.css\|scss" $D/README.md | head; grep -rn "ConfigItem\b" -A22 $D/build/esm/shared/types/config.d.ts | head -60; grep -n "DashKit\b\|DashKitProps\|interface\|class" $D/build/esm/index.d.ts $D/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts | head -30; ls $D/build/esm/components

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; grep -rln "\.css\|\.scss" $D --include=*.js | head; ls $D/components/DashKit; sed -n 1,60p $D/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts; sed -n 1,30p $D/shared/types/config.d.ts; cat $D/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.d.ts

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit; sed -n 440,560p $D/README.md; cat $D/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts; cat $D/build/esm/components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts; grep -n "Settings\b" -A25 $D/build/esm/typings/common.d.ts | head -70; cat $D/build/esm/plugins/Text/Text.d.ts | head -20

I=node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons; ls $I; for n in Plus Pencil Check ArrowRotateLeft ChartColumn ChartLine TextAlignLeft ListUl Heading Xmark; do ls $I/esm/$n.js $I/$n.js 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true; done; grep -E "\.\/(Plus|Pencil|Check|ArrowRotateLeft|ChartColumn|ChartLine|ListUl|TextAlignLeft|Bars|Persons|CircleCheck)\"" $I/package.json | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; sed -n 1,80p $D/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.js; grep -n "cols\|rowHeight\|margin" $D/constants/*.js | head; grep -n "i18n\|configure" -r $D/i18n/index.js | head -5; grep -n "Progress" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/Progress.d.ts | head -3; sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/Progress.d.ts

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; sed -n 1,60p $U/Progress/types.d.ts | grep -v "^\s*/\?\*"; grep -n "view\|type\|theme\|size" $U/Card/Card.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "export type TextVariant" -A3 $U/types.d.ts $U/Text/*.d.ts | head; grep -o "'[a-z0-9-]*'" $U/Label/Label.d.ts | sort -u | head -30
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8; rm -rf dist; git status --short
